governing: block shear rupture of the end plate at an end bolt (one-bolt block, AISC 360-22 J4.3), tied with base-metal shear rupture of the W21x44 web along the fillet welds (J2.4)
notes: Petra PASS, 16 of 16 checks certified, for Vu = 139.063 kip LRFD. Design: 1/4 in x 5-1/2 in x 1'-2 3/8 in A572 Gr 50 end plate; 8 x 3/4 in A325-N (Group 120, threads included) bolts, snug-tight, standard holes, in 2 lines at 3-1/2 in gauge, 4 rows at 3-1/2 in pitch, 1-15/16 in end edge distance and 1 in side edge distance (the Table J3.4 minimum); 1/4 in E70 fillet both sides of the beam web, effective length taken as plate length less 2 x weld size. Other high utilisations: bolt shear 0.972, weld metal 0.90, plate shear rupture 0.874. The plate must sit within the beam's flat web (T); centred, it does. Petra does not check end-plate rotational flexibility. I checked it by hand against AISC Manual Part 10 practice: plate thickness at most 3/8 in and gauge 3-1/2 to 5-1/2 in, both met. Do not substitute a thicker plate, a smaller gauge or A36 plate: A36 fails block shear at this width. The beam flange ends sit 1/4 in back from the column face, the plate thickness. Bolt-tightening clearance to the column web was checked (0.786).
